description: This file provides a polyfill implementation for bitwise operations such as Log2, TrailingZeroCount, and RoundUpToPowerOf2 for .NET Core 3.1 or earlier, specifically targeting the Orleans.Serialization.Utilities namespace.

classes.name: BitOperations
classes.description: A static class providing bitwise utility methods such as Log2, TrailingZeroCount, and RoundUpToPowerOf2, with fallback implementations for older .NET versions.

methods.name: Log2
methods.description: Calculates the floor of the base-2 logarithm of a uint or ulong value, with special handling for zero input.

methods.name: Log2SoftwareFallback
methods.description: Private method providing a software fallback implementation for Log2 for uint values, using bit manipulation and de Bruijn sequences.

methods.name: TrailingZeroCount
methods.description: Counts the number of trailing zero bits in a uint or ulong value, similar to the x86 TZCNT instruction.

methods.name: RoundUpToPowerOf2
methods.description: Rounds a uint value up to the nearest power of two, returning 0 if the input is 0 or if overflow occurs.
